entries.subject: CHARA raw data archive
entries.finding: Raw CHARA data are reached through an account on CHARA's Remote Data Reduction Machine, set up by contacting its data scientist; the pages checked state no eligibility and no anonymous download. This project does not contact people for access.
entries.revisitWhen: The user holds a CHARA account, or CHARA publishes raw data for anonymous download.

entries.subject: CHARA proprietary period and republishing reduced data
entries.finding: CHARA data become public after an 18-month proprietary period, except thesis data and long-term surveys. Whether reduced data may be copied off the remote machine or republished is not stated on the pages checked.
entries.revisitWhen: CHARA states terms for copying or republishing reduced data.

entries.subject: MIRC-X and MYSTIC reduction pipeline
entries.finding: The MIRC-X/MYSTIC pipeline is public under the MIT licence (jdmonnier/mircx_mystic) and installed on CHARA's remote machine; running it here was not tried, since there are no raw data to run it on.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw MIRC-X data are available to this project.

entries.subject: Calibrated CHARA files in the JMMC OiDB
entries.finding: A screen of the OiDB found one non-survey calibrated MIRC-X season on a star resolved enough to image: Polaris, April 2021. Its reconstruction does not beat a spotless disc (spot ratio 1.05), so Polaris ships shape-only.
entries.revisitWhen: New calibrated MIRC-X or MYSTIC imaging seasons of resolved stars appear in the OiDB.
